text: Professional positioning and training objectivesMaterials science and Engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that takes materials as its research object, covering material design, preparation, performance optimization and application, and integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as physics, chemistry and engineering. Its core objective is to cultivate compound talents with capabilities in material research and development, performance analysis, process optimization and engineering application, and to solve the material bottleneck problems in fields such as aerospace, electronic information, energy and medical care.
